description: This file defines data classes, enums, and a provider class for managing project template configuration, including project types, environment settings, build commands, and initialization info.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported project types with a method to create an enum member from a string.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration details for a project, including name, version, description, author, type, output path, and parameters, with methods to generate replaceable parameters and perform replacements in content.

classes.name: BuildCommand
classes.description: Contains build command details including command string and working directory.

classes.name: EnvironmentConfig
classes.description: Holds environment setup details such as versions of various tools and a flag indicating if environment is initialized.

classes.name: RunTool
classes.description: Configuration for a command-line tool to run.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Aggregates all information needed for initializing a project template, including build commands, environment, files, scripts, and URLs.

classes.name: TemplateConfigProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to load and parse template configuration data from a YAML file, applying project parameter replacements.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Creates a ProjectType enum member from a string value.

methods.name: get_replaceable_parameters
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of parameters that can be used to replace placeholders in templates.

methods.name: replace_parameters
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a given content string with actual project parameters.

methods.name: get_init_info
methods.description: Loads and returns the complete template initialization information from the configuration YAML file.
